** {{NPC location|Cliffs of Dohjok}} (near the portal to [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]])

* {{skill icon|Reversal of Damage}}
* {{skill icon|Signet of Mystic Wrath}}
* {{skill icon|Zealot's Fire}}
* {{monster skill icon|Natural Resistance}}

*[[Keshel's Staff]] ([[unique]])
*[[Rinkhal Talon]]
